facts.title: Blood Orange, Fennel and Avocado Salad with Lemon Citronette
ingredients: 1 bulb fennel, quartered, cored and sliced into super thin strips (reserve fennel fronds)
2 ounces (about ⅓ cup) goat cheese, crumbled
¼ cup olive oil, more to taste
1 lemon, preferably organic, zested and juiced
Sea salt and lots of freshly ground black pepper, to taste
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
